2034-5220-6961-7824-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-6961-7824-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

880-7893-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-7893-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

751-6723-6968.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

81-512-1719.easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
81-512-1719.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
81-512-1719.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

372-3899-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

2281-3175-3899.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5256-7399.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4365-4826-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1308-4772-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-4772-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4772-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Doubling Season
Repeat.

877-3081-3817-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7656-7693.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-7656-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2469-5220-6634-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

140-586-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2.

3129-4136-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3129-4136-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

944-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1818-2034-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-2034-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2638-4935-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-4935-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-4935-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

7-6867-6869.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures excluding Aang that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

224-225-3147-3314-3430.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {W} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-225-3147-3314-3430.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4222-5089-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
4222-5089-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
4222-5089-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

56-792-5075-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-792-5075-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Ogre Slumlord and Totentanz trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-792-5075-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

186-1497-4289-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-2733-5921-5954-6664.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

70-6532.description:
Cast Balancing Act by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Perch Protection by paying {4}{W}{W} and choosing to promise an opponent a gift, causing all permanents you control to phase out and an opponent to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Balancing Act, causing each opponent to sacrifice all their permanents as you control no permanents that aren't phased out.

586-5147-5258-5618-5687.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3249-4050-4939.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary, adding {R/G}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, adding {R}{G}.
Repeat.

500-813-1181.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Scholar of the Ages and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The two Scholar of the Ages tokens enter the battlefield, returning Sacrifice, if applicable, and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Scholar of the Ages token, adding seven {B}.
Repeat.
You may also return up to two other instants and/or sorceries using the Scholar of the Ages tokens if they can be cast using black mana to get infinite casts of those instants and/or sorceries.

1651-1737-4772.notablePrerequisites: Any artifact with mana value 0 exiled by Prototype Portal.
1651-1737-4772.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating two token copies of the imprinted artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two artifact tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

500-914-2047.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments; additional ones beyond this minimum can reduce the mana needed.
500-914-2047.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Dockside Extortionist and creating two 1/1 token copies of it.
When the Dockside Extortionist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least eight Treasure tokens in total.
Cast Mechanized Production by paying {2}{U}{U} while keeping at least seven Treasures on the battlefield, attaching it to a Treasure you control.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, causing you to create a token of the artifact Mechanized Production is attached to and win the game.

2950-3519-4115.notablePrerequisites: You do not control another Bird or Scout or have a Bird or Scout in your graveyard.
2950-3519-4115.description:
Cast Aven Surveyor by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a copy of the Aven Surveyor spell.
The Aven Surveyor copy enters, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Aven Surveyor token, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Aven Surveyor enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

618-3617-4125.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Shipwreck Dowser triggers, getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser with haste.
The token copy of Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2060-2854-2908-3062.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2854-2908-3062.description:
Cast Dream Stalker, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{U}.
Dream Stalker triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

65-717-2628-3855-5181.description:
Cycle Remote Isle for {0} due to Fluctuator.
Escape Protocol and Bone Miser trigger.
Stack the triggers such that Bone Miser's ability resolves first, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability using {1} to pay for it to blink Golgari Findbroker.
When Golgari Findbroker ETBs, return Remote Isle to your hand.
Resolve the cycling trigger and draw a card.
